UserBoard.title: UserBoard
UserBoard.description: A synchronized chalkboard workspace belonging to a specific user, storing theme, grid ruling, chalk strokes, and placed visual diagrams or notes.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the board owner.

title.description: Human-readable title of the lesson or study board.

gridType.description: Background ruling or coordinate grid mode.

strokes.description: Bounded array of drawn chalk, highlighter, or line strokes.

items.description: Bounded array of diagrams and highlighted note cards placed on the board.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the board was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last board synchronization.
